title: Queued full VIXEN builds can be terminated without a payload verdict
body: The required queued cmake --build build/wsl-debug was admitted twice, compiled to 12/366 and 51/355 targets, then the live wrapper ended with Terminated "$@" and no payload exit/status marker. A reduced --credits 1 recovery was required; the build should publish a durable timeout/termination reason and preserve the payload result.

title: Aggregate VIXEN codegen regen needs a bounded focused fallback
body: The queued aggregate cmake --build build/wsl-debug --target vixen_codegen_regen was terminated by the wrapper with no completed payload result; the documented focused view_editor_layers_regen target then completed successfully and was needed to continue. The aggregate regen target should report or resume its completed sub-targets instead of requiring manual narrowing.

title: VIXEN CMake presets need a source-root invocation guard
body: The detached wave witness was first invoked as cmake --preset vixen-wsl-debug from the repository root, but the preset file lives under VIXEN; that failed before configuration. The documented VIXEN configure route should locate the preset source root or emit the exact cmake -S VIXEN correction.

title: Queued CTest no-tests failures need usable shard diagnostics
body: The queued GPU split emitted a real CTest No tests were found diagnostic for disabled-only shards, but the wrapper classified it as PAYLOAD_FAIL with diagnostic_origin=unavailable and empty recognized source details. The split runner should classify disabled-only shards explicitly and preserve the CTest reason in the queue verdict.

title: EditorLayers binding changes should update golden test call sites
body: After the merged generated EditorLayersBind added materialCoverageCount and materialCoverageStale, the existing test_view_editor_layers_golden.cpp call still passed the old argument list and the full build failed with vector<EditorNodeRow>* to int* conversion. The view codegen check should expose or regenerate consumer call sites as one contract.

title: Queue PAYLOAD_FAIL must retain direct CTest failure output
body: The queued named CPU CTest command returned PAYLOAD_FAIL with an empty wrapper log even though the captured CTest log contained the two assertion failures and their source lines. Queue diagnostics should retain direct CTest payload output and classify test failures by test name instead of reporting only an unavailable payload diagnostic.

title: Windowed material witness needs documented DISPLAY bootstrap
body: Running cx_edmat8_material_witness.py directly through the real GPU queue exited before AppFlow because DISPLAY was unset; the documented windowed capture helper sets DISPLAY=:0 and unsets WAYLAND_DISPLAY, but this material witness does not. The witness should bootstrap or delegate the same display contract.

title: Material witness needs a d11-compatible coverage probe fallback
body: The material witness's appflow.material_probe returned that the generated MaterialId hit channel is unavailable at the editor procedural frame pin. Captures could proceed only with --skip-material-probe, relying on the UI coverage rows instead of point probes. The d11 generated payload/provider seam should expose a supported editor-frame probe or make the witness use the coverage provider declaratively.

title: Detached wave captures need an explicit Undertow text-shader provider
body: The exact wave 6444d7c2b detached VIXEN checkout could not configure because its older auto-derivation had no paired Undertow lane and required UNDERTOW_ROOT. The queued configure succeeded only after manually pointing at a generated provider worktree; detached capture setup should accept or derive a compatible provider explicitly.
